name: trae-pet
description: TRAE desktop pet — TypeScript + React + Electron with a visual configurator.
author: TRAE Pet

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:node && npm run build && node scripts/release-preflight.mjs
scripts.package:mac: export CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && npm run verify && npm run secure-core:build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: export CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && npm run verify && npm run secure-core:build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: export CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && npm run verify && npm run secure-core:build && electron-builder --mac --x64
